_comment: Config for scripts/sync-events.mjs. MEETUP: every active group in src/data/groups.json with a meetupUrl is checked automatically; list Meetup groups that are not in groups.json under extraMeetupGroups. Add a group name to skipGroups to stop syncing it (Hammerspace KC: mostly makerspace classes; Code and Coffee KC, Kansas City React Meetup, KC Game Developers: Meetup won't share their calendars). OTHER CALENDARS: icalFeeds lists any other public iCal feed (e.g. a Google Calendar's public .ics address). Set eventUrl when the feed has no per-event link, and includeTitlesMatching to take only some events. LOCATION: feeds rarely give one, so locations sets the city for a group's new events (default: Kansas City, MO, which the calendar hides). REMOVING: when you delete a synced event from events.json, add its link to ignoreEventUrls, or for feeds without per-event links add {group, date} to ignoreGroupDates, or the next run will add it back. Events whose title contains any skipTitlesMatching text (case-insensitive) are ignored.
